sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Kirti Uppal, Senior  with Mr. Harshit Jain, 
 Kumar, Ms. Riya Gulati,
 Himanshu Bidhuri, Advoc  versus  STATE .....
Through: Mr. Aman Usman, APP for  with Inspector Asha Sin  Rajouri Garden, Delhi.
CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 19.01.2023 CRL.M.A. 1360/2023 (Exemption) Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
The present application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeks anticipatory bail in FIR No. 614/2021 under Sections 498A/304B/406/34 Indian Penal Code, 1860, registered at P.S. Rajouri Garden.

Learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the FIR was initially registered on 16.07.2021 under Sections 306/498A/34 Indian Penal Code, 1860 against the husband of the complainant's deceased daughter and thereafter, in a supplementary statement dated 25.10.2021, allegations were made against the present applicant by the complainant.
On the basis of the said supplementary statement, Section 304B Indian Penal Code, 1860 was added in the FIR.
Learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the applicant is joining the investigation, as and when called by the Investigating Officer.
Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing.
